title: License information is incorrect
bug_description:
### 📚 The doc issue

In the PyTorch readme, it says that the license is PyTorch has a BSD-style license, as found in the [LICENSE](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/main/LICENSE) file.

When you go to the license file, it does not reference BSD. 

### Suggest a potential alternative/fix

I think it would be useful to reference that this is based on BSD, if only so that AI can parse it more easily and from a marketing perspective more clearly signal that it's based on a respected open source license.
